name: Verge Sport
note: US-founded custom cycle apparel maker (base in New York, head office in Poland, own production facility); the team's kit maker and an upper-chest sponsor from 2026. Verge Sport traces its roots to founder Mike Magur's 1996 New York custom-clothing business and his own production facility, per the company's About page and the 2026 kit launch (which calls Michael Magur the Verge Sport founder), but no source found names Verge's current shareholders — so the ownership chain does not reach a documented real owner and the sponsor stays unrated. No qualifying human-rights finding against the company was found.
